- Initial release of workday-fpx skill.
- Enables reading Workday HR data (org chart, profiles, tasks, pay, benefits, compensation, app menu) from the command line using the fpx CLI.
- No need to run the workday-mcp server; works via your signed-in *.myworkday.com browser tab using the Transporter extension.
- Supports fetching any *.htmld data endpoint with raw JSON output, ready for jq processing.
